description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read SKILL.md to understand the company-group pattern and the apply script. (2) Identify that /workspace/scripts/apply_feishu_group_company.py is the correct tool and run it with --config ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json --chat-id oc_abc123 --coordinator company-ceo --specialists company-ui company-dev. (3) The script must produce a patched openclaw.json where: top-level groupRules.oc_abc123.requireMention is true; company-ceo's per-account entry under channels.feishu.groups.oc_abc123 (PLURAL 'groups') has requireMention: false and a systemPrompt containing 'NO_REPLY'; company-ui and company-dev each have channels.feishu.groups.oc_abc123.requireMention: true; ALL legacy singular 'group' keys are removed from every account. The key proprietary trap is the counterintuitive requireMention: false for the coordinator bot, the mandatory use of 'groups' (plural) not 'group', and the NO_REPLY systemPrompt that must be scoped to the group.
